messages.en:
{07 01 00}I can't understand anyone
who doesn't like bug
hunting!
{07 0d 00}It's so much fun! {07 16 00}Well...{01 00 00 05 00}
unless you're a bug, then
it's maybe not so fun.
messages.et:
{07 01 00}Ma ei mõista kedagi,
kellele ei meeldi
putukajaht!
{07 0d 00}See on nii lõbus! {07 16 00}Noh...{01 00 00 05 00}
kui sa just pole putukas,
siis pole ehk nii lõbus.

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}So what do bugs mean to
you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 01 00 12 13 12}
They're friends!
They're bugs!
They're toys!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Nii, mida putukad sinu
jaoks on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 01 00 12 13 12}
Nad on sõbrad!
Nad on putukad!
Nad on mänguasjad!

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}Right on!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}Maybe you're not
so bad after all.

{07 06 00}Nothing gets my 
blood pumping like stalking
a rare bug, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Just nii!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}Ehk sa polegi
nii halb.

{07 06 00}Miski ei pane mu verd 
keema nii nagu haruldase
putuka jälitamine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 11 00}When I decide I want
something, I won't stop 'til
I get it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Watch this, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00}
I'm gonna show you how it's
done!
messages.et:
{07 11 00}Kui ma otsustan midagi
tahta, ei lõpeta ma enne,
kui saan, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Vaata seda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00}
Ma näitan sulle, kuidas
seda tehakse!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Shhh!{01 00 00 14 00} There's a bug right 
over there! Quiet, {01 00 00 05 00}fool!

{07 16 00}Step aside and let a real
pro take care of business,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Tšš!{01 00 00 14 00} Seal on putukas! 
Vaikselt, {01 00 00 05 00}tola!

{07 16 00}Astu kõrvale ja lase
tõelisel profil asja ajada,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
This might sound weird, but
do you think bugs and 
people can communicate?{02 00 00 10 10}
Of course!
You're crazy.
messages.et:
See võib kõlada veidralt,
aga kas putukad ja
inimesed saavad suhelda?{02 00 00 10 10}
Muidugi!
Sa oled hull.

messages.en:
